name.zh: 地面北欧离心及手撑复位
name.en: Floor Nordic Eccentric with Hand Reset

purpose.en: Build eccentric strength in the hamstrings.

text.zh: 跪姿固定脚跟，身体一条直线慢慢前倒
text.en: Kneel with your heels anchored and lower forward slowly in one straight line

text.zh: 用腿后侧控制下降速度
text.en: Use your hamstrings to control the descent.

text.zh: 控制不住时双手撑地，推回起始位
text.en: When you can no longer control it, catch yourself with your hands and push back up.

commonErrors.en: Bending at the hips too early.

cautions.zh: 从小幅度开始；腿后侧拉伤感或疼痛就停止
cautions.en: Start with a small range, and stop if you feel a strain or pain in your hamstrings.

cautions.zh: 膝下垫软垫，脚跟固定牢靠
cautions.en: Pad your knees and anchor your heels securely.
